name: points-activity
description: Extract loyalty points/miles activity from airline and hotel programs into a unified CSV using your own logged-in browser session.

plugins.name: points-activity
plugins.description: Extract loyalty points/miles account activity from airline and hotel programs (Hyatt, United, IHG, Accor, Aeroplan, plus a generic playbook for unsupported programs) into a unified CSV plus current balance. Uses your own logged-in browser session via the Claude in Chrome MCP — no credentials stored, no data leaves your machine.
